contributionSummary: Shows merit badges in member copy (MB-07): the badge-earned DM on every new badge, the next-badge line in the manual award DM, badge fields in /merit list, and /merit rank_list counts per badge tier (9 per page). Each switches only once the relevant badge role is configured, so nothing changes before cutover.
